Re-interpretation found the peeled §B IMPULSE verdict is a signed-residual counting artifact (residual std 41.2 vs wavelet sigma 8.4, spatial_corr=0.513, cross_ch=0.639) and did not re-test impulse; speckle (vm_slope=15.60) and the noise_prior-predicted gaussian_YCrCb were tested at their best severities and remain PARTIAL (0.0080/0.0081 mean_shift shortfalls). Poisson is the only family reproducing the residual positive mean shift (intensity-dependent bias) while holding sigma/clean-residual/variance_ratio; poisson:1 and poisson:2 both reach 4/4 on the single pair, so noise severity is unidentifiable. Global sev3 is bracketed (sat2 WEAK, sat4 PARTIAL). No alternative exceeds R0's 4/4 MATCH and no evidence justifies changing noise type/severity -> NO_CHANGE. k=1 limitation: all checks single-sample, noise sigma check fluctuates across seeds; residual_intensity_corr=0.4686/gamma_suspect remains an untested ambiguity (equally explained by chroma saturation + clipping + Poisson variance).
